overview.description: The Global X Emerging Markets Great Consumer ETF (EMC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed fund that invests in companies across multiple sectors that are positioned to benefit from the increasing consumption and growing purchasing power of consumers from the emerging markets. EMC was launched on Sep 24, 2010 and is issued by Global X.
